# Kiichin

> The #1 place for authentic Japanese goods including kitchenware, home products, figures, games, and manga with seamless global shipping.

Kiichin is an ecommerce platform specializing in curated Japanese products for international customers. The site offers guidance on shipping, customs, rewards programs, and features news updates on logistics changes affecting US and global orders.

## Key Topics

- Japanese goods
- Kitchenware
- Home products
- Ecommerce
- Global shipping
- US customs
- De minimis exemption
- Rewards program
- Discount codes
- Order tracking
- Import duties
- Japanese brands
- First-time shoppers
- Sales and deals

## Getting Started

- [Kiichin Homepage](https://kiichin.com): Main landing page showcasing Japanese kitchenware, figures, games, manga, and more
- [First Shopper's Guide: How to Use Kiichin Site](https://kiichin.com/pages/how-to-use-kiichin-site): Comprehensive guide for new shoppers covering navigation, discounts, shipping options, and rewards programs

## News & Updates

- [Important Update: Latest Situation with USA Shipping Parcels](https://kiichin.com/blogs/news/de-minimis-exemption-to-end): Critical update on USA tariffs and de minimis exemption ending August 29, 2025, affecting international shipments
- [News](https://kiichin.com/blogs/news): News and lifestyle guides featuring Japanese home products, culture, and shopping insights
